name: Analysis Matrix
purpose: To present two parallel analysis streams (e.g., competitor vs. target group) with their respective findings.
use_when: When you need to show a structured breakdown of two different analysis categories and their resulting outcomes.
avoid_when: When presenting a linear process, a single deep-dive analysis, or data-heavy charts.
notes: The layout uses a mirrored structure: left-side context, center image, and right-side detailed findings with icons.
